one-list.problem: Leads pile up in a sheet no one owns.
one-list.lume: Every enquiry lands in one list, with its stage and its owner.

needs-you.problem: New leads go cold while everyone thinks someone else replied.
needs-you.lume: LUME spots the leads with no one on them. Two clicks assign them all.

follow-up.lume: Set the next one in a click. Anything missed comes first.

whatsapp.problem: Typing the same WhatsApp message 40 times a day.
whatsapp.lume: One tap, their name already in, sent from your own WhatsApp.

queue.lume: Or work through a whole list: LUME opens each chat with the message ready.

calendar.problem: The call's on Calendly, the notes in a notebook, the lead in a sheet.
calendar.lume: Calendly and Google Calendar meetings sit beside their lead. Then mark the win.

analytics.problem: You can't see which source or which rep is actually working.
analytics.lume: What each source costs and wins, and every rep side by side.

rep.problem: When a rep leaves, your leads can leave with them.
rep.lume: Each rep sees only their own leads.

security.lume: And every export carries a hidden mark that says whose it was.
